chapter.verse: Tua ciangin vantung ah kihilna lim lianpi khat kilang hi. Ni a silh, a khe nuai-ah kha a om, numei khat hi a, a lu tungah aksi sawmlenih a tuang kumpi-lukhu om hi.
Tua numei pen a gai hi a, nausuak natna leh nausuak gimna tawh nakpi-in awng hi.
Tua ciangin vantung ah kihilna lim a dang khat kilang hi. En un, gulpi samneia a san a lian khat hi a, lutang sagih leh saki sawm nei-in tua lutangte' tungah kumpi-dialkhip sagih om hi.

Tua gulpi samnei in a mei tawh vantung aksite seh thum-ah-khat nilkhia-in leitung ah lawnkhiasuk hi. Tua ciangin numeinu' nausuah hun ah tua naungek a nek theih nadingin nausuak dinga kithawi numeinu' mai-ah ding hi.
Numeinu nausuakin tapasal khat nei a, tua naungek pen sik ciangkhut tawh minam khempeuh a uk ding hinapi Pasian' kiang, a kumpi-tokhom tungah kilato hi.
Tua ciangin numeinu zong gamgawtak sung, ama' adinga Pasian' bawlkholhsak mun khat ah ni 1,260 sung khoina vakna ngah dingin taikhia hi.
Tu-in vantung ah galkidona om a, Michael leh ama' vanmite in gulpi samnei do uh hi. Gulpi samnei leh ama' vanmite in zong dokik uh hi.
Ahi zongin gulpi samnei in zo zolo ahih manin vantung ah amau' ading mun om nawnlo hi.
Tua ciangin dawimangpa lah a kici, Satan zong a kici, leitung bup a khempa, tanglai gulpi ahi gulpi samnei golpi pen leitung ah kilawnsuk a, ama' vanmite zong amah tawh kilawnsukkhawm hi.

Tua ciangin vantung pan awging lianpi khat ka za a, hih bangin ci hi: “Tu-in i Pasian ii hotkhiatna, vangliatna leh kumpigam ahi zongin, ama' Khris ii uktheihna thu ahi zongin hong tung khinta hi. A hang pen i sanggamte a ngawhpa, a sun a zanin Pasian' mai-ah amaute a ngawhpa, kilawnkhiasuk khinzo hi.
Amaute in tua a ngawhpa pen Tuuno' sisan tawh ahi zongin, a teci panna uh tawh ahi zongin zo khinzo uh hi. A hang pen amaute in sihna thu nangawn ah a nuntakna uh iplah lo uh ahih man hi.

Tua hangin vantungte leh a sunga omte khempeuh aw, lungdam un! Ahi zongin leitung leh tuipi aw, na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen dawimangpa in ama' hun tawm ta cih thei ahih manin nakpi lungsona tawh note' kiangah hong paisuk khinta hi.”
Gulpi samnei in amah leitung ah kilawnsuk khinzo cih a kitheih ciangin naungek tapasal a nei numeinu sulzuih hi.

Ahih hangin gulpi' maingatna mun pan a lenkhiat nadingin leh hun khat, hunte leh hun langd sung khoina vakna a ngah nading mun, gamgawtak lak a zuat theih nadingin numeinu' tungah muvanlai golpi ii kha a langnih kipia hi.
Gulpi in a kam pan tui phulsak a, numeinu tui' taihmang dingin numeinu' nungah gun bangin tui luangsak hi.
Ahih hangin leitung hong pai-in numeinu huh a, a kam ka-in gulpi samnei kam pana a luangkhia gun nawmvalh hi.
Gulpi samnei zong numeinu' tungah heh mahmah a, numei' suanlekhak a omlai teng ahi Pasian' thupiaknate a zui, Jesu' teci panna a lenkip mite tawh galkido dingin kuankhia hi.
Tua ciangin tuipi piaunel tungah amah ding hi.
